summary: The patched package (solution/fix.patch applied by solve.sh) implements every HC-4 rule the instruction makes graded (reading floor, 80.0 threshold inclusive, 85/3 reference duration, sampled time over all readings, partial-survey projection to the worker's own shift, whole-shift-or-longer measured dose, 85+3log2 TWA, half-up tenth rounding, 82/85 status bands on the reported TWA, impulse at >=140.0, group dose as mean of all member shift doses with status from TWA alone), keeps today's step exactly where the manual is silent (above-ceiling counted level, sub-three-quarter surveys), and leaves the driver untouched. No concrete incorrect behaviour found.
checks_performed: Reconciled all 24 manifest entries against files read in full (no truncation).

Verified every fix.patch hunk header and context against the shipped files (flags.py 9-13, groups.py 4-10 and 14-25, levels.py 6-14 and 20-23, runs.py 4-24, shift.py 11-20, twa.py 2-21 and 25-31) so `patch -p1` from / applies cleanly to /app/src; tools/noisedose_run.py is not in the patch.
Traced patched runs.measure: non-readings (0.0) skipped; every reading (>=40.0) adds to sampled time; counted level min(level,115.0); dose added only when counted >= 80.0 using 480/2^((L-85)/3).

Traced patched shift.shift_dose branches: sampled>=shift -> measured; 4*sampled>=3*shift -> measured*shift/sampled (exact integer three-quarter test); else original step (0 when nothing sampled, scale to 480 when sampled<480, else measured).

Traced twa_for (85+3log2(D/100), None at dose 0), to_tenth (floor(10v+0.5)/10), status_for (>85.0 over, >=82.0 action) applied to the reported TWA; report.worker_row forces 'over' when ceiling or impulse.

Traced patched groups.group_rows: mean of every member's shift dose including zero doses, TWA from that mean, status without flags; codes sorted by Python string order (ASCII digits before capitals, matching README).

Hand-traced ordinary and boundary cases: steady 80.0 dBA 480 min (counted, dose 50%), 79.9 dBA (reading, no dose), 115.0 vs 115.1 (ceiling flag only above), peak 140.0 (impulse), shift 600 with 450 sampled (partial, projected to 600), shift 360 with 420 sampled (measured unscaled), quiet group member dose 0 included in mean.

Considered exact-half TWA rounding: in real arithmetic an unrounded TWA cannot equal an odd multiple of 0.05 for one-decimal levels (a rational combination of 2^(j/30) cannot equal 2^(odd/60)), so floor(10v+0.5) and exact half-up agree on the contract domain apart from float noise within ~1e-13 dB, which is not a contract-defined case.
